citations.claim: At first violation step 285, N approach queued 45 vehicles waiting 201s at red while phase stuck in all-red before NS
At step 280, EW still green with N waiting 196s and detector_fail on W active
At step 180, EW green held continuously with N waiting 96s despite max_green 90

counterfactual.change: Removed the single detector_fail event on W; all other fields identical. Without blinded W detector, actuated control cycles normally and no max_wait violation.

explanation: With actuated control, EW green started ~step 90. Detector_fail on W (t72 duration 209) blinds that approach while E has heavy arrivals (0.4/s), so controller sees persistent EW demand/never gap-out and fails to enforce max_green_seconds=90 or long-wait recall for NS. N queues from step ~84 onward and waits 201s by step 285, violating max_wait.

violation.detail: approach 0 has waited 201 s at red with vehicles queued (limit 200)

vision_note: The north approach shows a long blue queue held at red while the east-west direction holds green then yellow across steps 282-284. By step 285 all approaches are red but the north and east queues have only grown longer, showing the NS approach starved for a very long time.
